title: John Harbaugh reacts to offensive performances in first preseason game as Giants head coach

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: John Harbaugh reacts to offensive performances in first preseason game as Giants head coach
sources.description: In what was a relatively low-scoring affair, which is to be expected for the first game of the preseason, there were still a lot of things that can be gleaned from the Giants.
